subject: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR
content:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: danielle.park@acme.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR

Team —

Quick primer as we head into the QBR / launch board next week. I attached the launch-readiness-matrix.xlsx with the rows I’ll present. High level asks:

- GTM: confirm final channel readiness and sales materials (Kim).
- Enablement: confirm playbook completion, delivery schedule, and whether we can do the two-hour enablement for customer champions (Kim/Laura).
- Pricing & Packaging: final list of supported SKUs and any promotional credits (Vivek).
- Docs: publish migration and troubleshooting guides by Friday (Laura).
- Support: Triage SLA, on-call rotations, and runbook signoffs (Tessa).

Please reply with one-line status + blocker if any. I’ll synthesize into the QBR one-pager by EOD and share with execs.

Attachments: launch-readiness-matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Launch Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:18:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR

Marcus —

Status (GTM & Enablement):
- Sales materials: pitch deck and objection handling doc are final; slide deck uploaded to the shared Drive link.
- Playbook: enablement-playbook-v2.pdf attached, covers champion training and 2-hr session agenda.
- Delivery: we can run the customer-champion 2-hour session on the day after GA and schedule two follow-ups within the first 30 days.

Blockers: one demo environment bug (auth header mismatch) is blocking a sample flow. Engineering has a patch staged; Karthik, can you confirm ETA on the patch deploy?

-Kim
Sr. Manager, GTM Enablement

Attachments: enablement-playbook-v2.pdf

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:45:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR

Kim / Marcus —

Confirmed: patch is on the canary cluster now; QA passed smoke tests. We plan to promote to staging tonight (23:30 PDT) and GA code freeze is on schedule assuming no regressions.

I’ll post the canary run results to the drive link after the staging promotion. No change to timeline unless the canary surfaces perf regression at sequence lengths we care about.

-Karthik
VP, Orchestration & Runtime

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:12:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR

Marcus / team —

Docs status:
- Migration guide (customer-facing) — draft complete, needs final SME review (expected by Thursday AM).
- Troubleshooting playbook — first pass done; will add runbook commands and error codes by Thursday PM.
- API changelog & sample requests — ready and staged in docs site preview.

Blockers: Need a final confirmation on the deprecated endpoints list from API owners (Vivek, can you confirm we'll keep v1/rerank for 90 days?).

I’ll be at the QBR dry run Friday at 09:00.

-Laura
Head of Documentation

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR

Dropping in pricing & packaging status:
- Final SKUs: Base Inference, Dedicate Pool, Private Instance. Bundles and enterprise add-ons (SLA retention, premium observability) OK.
- Promotional credits: approved up to 3 months for proof-of-concept; requires sales intake form (HubSpot HS-48291) signed.
- Deprecated endpoints lifecycle: we’ll maintain v1/rerank for 90 days post-GA and then auto-redirect with a migration notice. Laura, consider that confirmed for docs.

Open item: need estimate on expected trial-to-paid conversion uplift from enablement program to justify promo budget. Kim — can you provide a back-of-envelope conversion delta by EOD?

-Vivek
GM, Pricing & Partnerships

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch ops primer & gap rundown — final prep for QBR

Marcus / all —

Support & operations status:
- SLA: we have a draft SLA for GA customers; Tier-1 triage runbook and escalation ladder done.
- On-call: rotation set, two people per day for first 14 days post-GA; added 1 extra hand for the first 72 hours.
- Runbooks: will be posted to the internal runbook repo tomorrow morning.

Blockers: Need access to the final playbook and the completed troubleshooting doc to finish playbook-specific runbook steps (Laura/Kim). Also want the finalized list of endpoints that will remain for the 90-day window.

If nothing else, I’ll assume green for the QBR brief and highlight the few outstanding asks.

-Tessa
Sr. Manager, Customer Support

---

[Marcus Lin synthesized summary to the exec QBR pack]

Status: Overall green-to-yellow. Engineering delivered a canary patch and timeline remains intact. Enablement & docs are on track with small SME items outstanding. Pricing approved promotional credits subject to HubSpot intake form. Support has runbooks and on-call coverage but requires final docs/playbook.

Open asks for QBR slide:
- Kim: provide conversion uplift estimate for promo allocation (EOD Thu).
- Laura: confirm docs SME signoff and publish schedule (Thu end-of-day).
- Tessa: confirm runbook upload link once posted (Fri AM).

I'll incorporate these into the QBR one-pager and share the final pack by 18:00 PT today.

Attachments referenced: launch-readiness-matrix.xlsx, enablement-playbook-v2.pdf

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-launch-qbr-materials; HubSpot: HS-48291

-- End of thread --
